_meta.title: ScoutIQ Proof of Concept Pipeline
_meta.status: Product Management Case Study - Illustrative Data

objective: Closed-Loop EV Battery Recycling & Hydrometallurgical Purity

claims.claim: Continuous hydrometallurgical pilot operating at 1,000 t/year capacity in Stuttgart.
Achieves 95.8% recovery yield of battery-grade lithium carbonate (>99.6% purity).
Assignee of granted patent covering selective organic acid leaching without chlorine emissions.
Reduces cradle-to-gate greenhouse gas emissions by 68% compared to pyrometallurgical smelting.
Commercial capex estimated at $42M with EBITDA positive return at 8,000 t/year utilization.
Secured commercial off-take contract for 3,000 t/year with German OEM.

ranked_shortlist.recommendation: Priority 1: Immediate sample assay and JDA negotiation for continuous pilot integration.

claims.claim: Operates 500 t/year demonstration facility in Hamilton, Ontario under environmental permit.
Demonstrates 94.2% lithium extraction without requiring high-pressure autoclaves.
Proprietary ionic liquid solvent regenerates with 99% efficiency over 50 cycles.
Single supplier dependency on specialty quaternary ammonium salts.

ranked_shortlist.recommendation: Priority 2: Qualified secondary partner; audit ambient solvent loss rates.

claims.claim: Operates 15,000 t/year commercial pyrometallurgical furnace in Lyon under environmental authorization.
New secondary fluxing process recovers 85% of lithium from smelting slag.
Carbon footprint exceeding 3.8 kg CO2/kg creates compliance risk under 2027 EU Battery Regulation.

ranked_shortlist.recommendation: Priority 3: High throughput stopgap; trade-off on lithium recovery and carbon emissions.
